correctness.rationale: For each nonadjacent pair of base fibers, graph geodesics project and lift exactly; internal fiber eligibility is exactly nonfull selection, proving the all-set equivalence for all connected bases and clique sizes at least two. The simplicial composition is an equality of faces. Ayzenberg 2013 Corollary 6.2 gives the integral join homotopy type, including the augmented empty-face case. Facet and face counts follow by disjoint decomposition over full-fiber indices; cycle obstructions give actual joins of simplex boundaries, hence PL spheres. A standalone verifier checked 814 connected labeled graph/fiber profiles (775472 subsets), 5632 direct BFS shortest-path cases, and mod-two homology in six cycle examples. These checks corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The theorem transfers an entire graph-geodesic complex through arbitrary nonuniform clique substitution, with every face/facet coefficient, minimal obstruction and an integral homology shift preserving torsion. The infinite cyclic case identifies explicit combinatorial spheres, exact facet counts, and a nontrivial dimension discontinuity at the four-cycle. These structural data are not recoverable from the previously known maximum total-visibility number alone; the mathematical motivation is categorical behavior of visibility complexes under graph substitution, rather than an arbitrary finite parameter.
